title: 3.0.0.2 dev-n TDD not agree with pump
symptom: On the Actions tab, the TDD (Total Daily Dose) shown in AAPS does not agree with the pump on some days. For example, one day shows a red line and another day shows exactly the same data, both about half of the pump's value. The pump shows 25.1U on the 1st and 19.6U on the 30th, while AAPS shows different values.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. User Philoul suggests that priming done from AAPS are included in TDD and bolus in pump, and extended bolus (fake TBR) are in bolus in pump and in basal in stats, which could cause inconsistencies, but this is speculative.
fix: No fix is provided in the thread. The issue was closed for inactivity.
evidence_quote: I never use this TDD button because results are less accurate than values in stats. - Priming done from aaps are included in TDD and bolus in pump (so every 3 days inconsistant values) - extended bolus (fake TBR) are in bolus in pump and in basal in stats.
